decisions.reason: Premium support sits close to the core agency-focused service, costs little to keep on offer since it draws on existing support staff, and serves as a profitable option for upselling, so there is no reason to abandon it.

The version management tool builds on the platform, was promoted alongside the firm's other core tools, and has low marginal cost once developed, so keeping it preserves value in the tool suite that reduces recurring work.

The data processing contract generator is distant from the core hosting business and had value mainly during the GDPR rush of 2018, so by 2022 that uncertainty has resolved toward limited value and abandoning it frees resources for core projects.
Scalable agency hosting is central to the firm's strategy and was featured on the home page, which signals strong commitment and a promising option worth expanding rather than dropping.
